title: Moonflower
description: A mod that adds a new flower and potion effect based on the phase of the moon
body:
**Moonflower is a mod that adds a new flower crop, as well as a new potion that gives different effects based on the phase of the moon.**

Moonflowers can be found growing on unique vines in Jungle biomes, and can be harvested using shears without breaking the block. When fully grown, the flower will open during the night and close during the day. The flower can also be brewed into a Potion of Moon's Blessing, which provides different effects based on the moon's phase. If the sun is out, the potion will do nothing. The potion is most powerful during the full moon, granting haste, speed, strength, jump boost, and night vision. The potion will grant night vision no matter the moon phase, while other effects will be phased out as the moon shrinks. For instance, the gibbous moon will only grant speed, strength, jump boost, and night vision, while the crescent moon will only grant jump boost and night vision. undefined

 

Art was made by the wonderful IcyDwarf!

 

If you come across any bugs, you can report them to the GitHub!
